mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0'
